# DAFO SAP Connect

> Local gateway that exposes SAP Business One data as read-only MCP tools for AI assistants and server-side applications on the same computer. Connect to `SAP_CONNECT_URL` (default `http://127.0.0.1:50002/mcp`) with `Authorization: Bearer <SAP_CONNECT_API_KEY>`, discover tools with `tools/list` and call them with `tools/call`.

The complete, self-contained integration file for AI coding assistants is `llms-full.txt`. Read it first.

## AI integration

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabgiani/dafo-sap-connect-downloads/main/llms-full.txt): what it enables, key concepts, connect, rules for AI assistants, recipes (Python, TypeScript, curl), request and response shapes, errors and retries, limits, security, use with DAFO Swarm, endpoint index, version notes

## Docs

- [How it works](https://github.com/gabgiani/dafo-sap-connect-downloads/blob/main/docs/concepts.md): architecture, tool families, access modes, publication rules, limits
- [Connect an AI client](https://github.com/gabgiani/dafo-sap-connect-downloads/blob/main/docs/connect-ai-client.md): access tokens, DAFO Swarm, Claude Desktop, VS Code, troubleshooting
- [Use the MCP server from an application](https://github.com/gabgiani/dafo-sap-connect-downloads/blob/main/docs/connect-from-an-app.md): protocol, SDK examples, integration patterns
- [Tool reference](https://github.com/gabgiani/dafo-sap-connect-downloads/blob/main/docs/tool-reference.md): arguments and result fields of every tool family
- [Online or scheduled queries](https://github.com/gabgiani/dafo-sap-connect-downloads/blob/main/docs/online-vs-scheduled.md): live queries versus local snapshots
- [Organizing SAP information for the AI](https://github.com/gabgiani/dafo-sap-connect-downloads/blob/main/docs/sap-specialist-guide.md): read tools, investigations, topic selection
- [How the AI understands SAP data](https://github.com/gabgiani/dafo-sap-connect-downloads/blob/main/docs/how-the-ai-understands-data.md): knowledge cards, interpretation rules, field dictionary
